title: Jet-Powered Drones Pound Kyiv Hours After Zelenskyy-Trump Talks, Killing 2
detail: Russia struck Kyiv with a wave of jet-powered attack drones early on September 23, hours after President Zelenskyy's meeting with President Trump at the UN. Drones hit a four-story business center, a gas station and warehouses in the Holosiivskyi district; set ablaze the historic Shayba railway market and hit a nine-story residential building and a transportation company in the Solomianskyi district; and started a warehouse fire in the Darnytskyi district. Railway infrastructure near Kyiv's Central Station was damaged, and drone debris fell between residential buildings. Data centers serving internet providers Pavutina and UTELS were destroyed, cutting internet access for roughly 100,000 households. At least 2 people were killed and more than 40 injured. Ukrainian oil company Ukrnafta said one of the two petrol stations hit was the sixth of its stations attacked in recent weeks. Zelenskyy said "a significant number" of the drones used were jet-powered, which are faster and harder to intercept.

media.caption: Emergency crews respond after Russian drones struck Kyiv, damaging the historic Shayba market and a petrol station, Sept. 23, 2026

title: Russian Aerial Bombs Kill 5, Trap Children Under Rubble in Oleksandrivka, Donetsk Oblast
detail: Russian aircraft dropped four aerial bombs on Oleksandrivka, Kramatorsk Raion, Donetsk Oblast, around 10:00 on September 23. Regional administration head Vadym Filashkin said the death toll rose to 5 killed and 6 wounded, including a child born in 2021; seven people, including two children born in 2024 and 2025, were reported trapped under rubble as search-and-rescue operations continued. The strike destroyed an apartment building and damaged 11 more apartment buildings, 42 private homes, a kindergarten, a shop, an administrative building and six vehicles.

media.caption: Rescuers search rubble after a Russian aerial bomb strike on Oleksandrivka, Donetsk Oblast, killed 5 people, Sept. 23, 2026
